text: At d_model=128, do random force controls rise enough (about 0.61 at d128 vs 0.55-0.63 at d64 with m2 fixed) that the N=64 vs N=128 comparison has to rely only on trained R2? If width closes the trained-R2 gap, does the deficit at d64 track a capacity measure such as d_model per bit of orbit-scale information?
